current_behavior: Defines generic AI texturing folders, reports, profile CSV, prefab binding CSV, and black-box dump path.
product_face_risk: Generic paths can become product-face authority by accident.
required_guard: Add ProductFace-specific manifest/report/material/texture paths; keep Shinobu269 generic folders diagnostic.
future_write_scope: New ProductFace constants or new ProductFace validator files only.
verification_required: Static source review plus Unity editor dry-run before implementation.

current_behavior: Applies import policy to managed AI textures under Assets/_Project/Textures/AI_Texturing.
product_face_risk: ProductFace textures placed there inherit generic AI route and filename-token semantics.
required_guard: ProductFace import folder must be separate and manifest-gated before importer policy applies.
future_write_scope: Future ProductFace AssetPostprocessor or guarded branch only.
forbidden_behavior: Broad import processing outside declared ProductFace folder and manifest rows.
verification_required: Unity import log plus import setting report.

current_behavior: Classifies _arm, _mask, _packed as Arm; normals/albedo/control maps from filename tokens.
product_face_risk: MRAO, ARM, ORM, and PackedV1 can be confused by filenames.
required_guard: Use filename classification only as hint; manifest packed_layout is authority.
future_write_scope: Validator can read AITextureImportPolicy but must enforce ProductFace manifest layout.
forbidden_behavior: Treating _packed or _mask as universal MRAO/ARM truth.
verification_required: Static validator test with MRAO and ARM sample rows.

current_behavior: Sets albedo sRGB, normal TextureImporterType.NormalMap, non-readable textures, mipmaps, Standalone BC5/BC7, Android ASTC_6x6.
product_face_risk: Good base, but ProductFace categories need explicit max size and platform consequences.
required_guard: Require manifest max_size and GlobalQualityWeight lane note; reject sRGB/mask/normal mismatches.
future_write_scope: ProductFace import policy and report outputs.
forbidden_behavior: Runtime Texture2D creation/compression or readable imported world textures.
verification_required: Unity import settings report for albedo normal and packed maps.

current_behavior: Copies inbox PNG files into generic imported texture folder with overwrite enabled and imports them.
product_face_risk: Filename collision can replace ProductFace evidence silently.
required_guard: ProductFace inbox must reject duplicate product_face_id and content hash collisions unless explicit revision row exists.
future_write_scope: New ProductFace inbox copier or collision guard.
forbidden_behavior: Overwriting imported ProductFace texture by matching filename alone.
verification_required: Static duplicate-file test plus Unity import dry-run.

current_behavior: Creates or loads MAT_assetKey_UberNoir material and assigns imported texture maps.
product_face_risk: ProductFace materials may be forced into UberNoir even when tool, visor, glass, bio, or PackedV1 shader contracts differ.
required_guard: Manifest must declare shader_path and allowed material family before material creation.
future_write_scope: ProductFace material binder may create materials only under Assets/_Project/Materials/ProductFace.
forbidden_behavior: Generic UberNoir material creation as proof for all ProductFace categories.
verification_required: Material validation report and shader property audit.

current_behavior: Binds albedo to _BaseMap/_MainTex, ARM to _ArmMap/_MaskMap/_MetallicGlossMap, normal to _BumpMap/_NormalMap and enables _NORMALMAP.
product_face_risk: Binding multiple property aliases can mask wrong channel dialect.
required_guard: Bind only properties declared by the manifest shader contract; reject ambiguous alias fan-out.
future_write_scope: ProductFace binder with shader-specific property table.
forbidden_behavior: Binding ARM texture into MRAO/PackedV1 shader slots without conversion proof.
verification_required: Static shader property matrix plus Unity material inspector proof.

current_behavior: Reads generic prefab-binding CSV and matches assetKey to prefabPath, rendererPath, materialSlot.
product_face_risk: Can broadly mutate product prefabs when a row matches.
required_guard: Disable for ProductFace categories; require ProductFace relink owner and dry-run diff first.
forbidden_behavior: ProductFace prefab mutation during import or generic AI material binding.
verification_required: Dry-run prefab relink report before any SaveAsPrefabAsset call.

current_behavior: Loads prefab contents, replaces renderer.sharedMaterials[slot], and saves prefab asset.
product_face_risk: Direct prefab write path is already functional and high blast-radius.
required_guard: Validator must reject wildcard paths, empty rendererPath, out-of-range slot, missing owner, and non-RELINK_READY status.
future_write_scope: Only relink owner after explicit implementation task.
forbidden_behavior: Folder-wide binding, all-renderers binding, runtime material clones, direct source-prefab mutation from import phase.
verification_required: Unity editor dry-run then controlled prefab save proof if later authorized.

current_behavior: Scans material folders for missing _ArmMap and albedo sRGB false; writes setup and shared rendering reports.
product_face_risk: Current scan is too generic for ProductFace channel contracts.
required_guard: Add ProductFace scanner for albedo/normal/packed maps, shader layout, default material debt, and forbidden fallback slots.
forbidden_behavior: Claiming material readiness from only missing ARM and albedo sRGB checks.
verification_required: Static scan plus Unity material audit report.

current_behavior: Keeps 300 AITextureBakeTelemetryEntry records and dumps Dump_SHINOBU_269.bin on critical bake paths.
product_face_risk: ProductFace import/relink failures need their own forensic ownership and dump route.
required_guard: Use distinct ProductFace black-box dump path and record manifest row id, stage, hash, warning flags.
future_write_scope: New ProductFace telemetry ring or guarded extension.
forbidden_behavior: Saying black-box exists for ProductFace without ProductFace stage/hash fields.
verification_required: Dump artifact from forced validation failure when implementation exists.

current_behavior: Writes generic AI texture ingestion report with asset path, map kind, max size, format hash, flags, compression, rollback fence, status.
product_face_risk: Report does not prove ProductFace visual quality, channel correctness, or prefab safety.
required_guard: ProductFace report must include manifest id, category, shader path, packed_layout, map roles, and prefab-write status DRY_RUN_ONLY.
forbidden_behavior: Upgrading static report to runtime/editor/visual/profiler proof.
verification_required: git diff check, Import-Csv row count, static term cross-check, later Unity report.
